body.x: The economical recession undoubtedly has caused a severe shock in every social, political or cultural aspect, however in Greece, people continue in searching for ways of recovering; of standing out. Art, music and of course the latest entry, design are the most important of them. Design constitutes one of the most powerful communication codes among the nations.

Occasioned by the international furniture and decoration fair Imm Cologne, Greece speaks design to everybody! During the fair which will be held from the 16th to 22nd of January of 2012, 6 Greek established furniture companies (CANDIA STROM, CORPUS, DE-CODE, ELITE STROM, LATTAS and MORPHOS) say yes to the challenge and join their strengths under the communication brand "Furniture from Greece"(http://www.furniturefromgreece.com). Furniture from Greece constitutes the first team effort on the part of the country, in order to show that Greece is still a country which has many things to offer.

Bearing this in mind, certain of the most talented and internationally awarded designers of the country have been assigned by the companies to do their best and create products that distinguish for their design, excellent materials and authenticity. They intend to combine tradition with the innovative element and in this way to form the so-called "Greek Furniture". Ultimate aim? Greek Furniture and consequently design, to become widely known so as to reach a point that everyone can recognize it and distinguish it from the rest.
Don't miss the latest trends of Greek Furniture by visiting at the pavilion of "Furniture From Greece" at Hall 5.2 of imm cologne.

Meanwhile imm Cologne is one of the most prestigious international furniture fairs as well as the central meeting place for exhibitors and decision-makers from all the world's important markets. All the target groups related to furniture and decoration are present there: contacts from all areas of the trade and industry, contract business experts, professionals from the architecture scene and the sectors' up-and-coming young professionals.
